proof_body:
by
  intro d x hx
  refine ⟨fun hu => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Zsqrtd.norm_eq_one_iff] at hu
    rw [hu] at hx
    exact Nat.not_prime_one hx
  · rintro a b rfl
    rw [Zsqrtd.norm_mul, Int.natAbs_mul] at hx
    rcases Nat.prime_mul_iff.mp hx with ⟨_, hb⟩ | ⟨_, ha⟩
    · right; exact Zsqrtd.norm_eq_one_iff.mp hb
    · left; exact Zsqrtd.norm_eq_one_iff.mp ha
target_source: ∀ (d : ℤ) (x : Zsqrtd d), Nat.Prime x.norm.natAbs → Irreducible x
